name: Laws of the Republic of Nauru (Constitution, Public Service Act and 187 principal Acts)
label: Nauru
record_note: The Constitution and Public Service Act have dated reprint histories. The 187 additional principal Acts each have one current-text baseline dated by the latest operative date in the official Table of Amendments. Earlier wording is not represented for those Acts. Ten expressly repealed Acts and one Act with an unresolved conditional repeal are excluded; this is partial coverage.

dates.commit: in-force (the operative date printed in the history note, else the commencement in the Table of Amendments, else the reprint's consolidation date)
dates.append_only_reader: per-act history; an appended Act can have an earlier source in-force date

author.consolidated: RONLAW (Department of Justice and Border Control)

scope.when_absent: no scope note found; not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.meaning: a written law does not commence retrospectively unless it clearly says so, and a repeal or amendment does not affect the previous operation of the law, rights acquired or accrued, or proceedings already begun under it
default_reach.authority: Interpretation Act 2011 (Nauru), sections 22(3) and 28(1); section 21: a provision commences at the beginning of its day
